title: LLV-GBANK250Q25C: compact half-log quantum bank with quarter-source copies

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the one physical LLV-GBANK250Q25C interpreter of proof.md executing the complete virtual.md program recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch charged work is O(2^(sqrt(n)log2(n)+(9/2)sqrt(n))), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. The selected complete virtual program is LLV-GHL250Q25 with its exact quarter-source half-log parameters, original guards, partial finishing calls, failed work, all-modulus decoders and finite branch preserved. The actual compact full-vector/two-label-root reservations, fixed maximal region addresses, every bank bit/field/address operation, coherent control, source SWAP, initialization and cleanup is charged. The sharper internal exponent sqrt(n)log2(n)+(35/8+1/1024)sqrt(n)+o(sqrt n) has exact positive gap127/1024 absorbing all fixed polynomial bank overhead into the exact envelope. All five claims concern this one physical implementation.

For the same physical LLV-GBANK250Q25C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak allocated classical space is O(n) bits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. It includes N, output, a fixed number of O(n)-bit staging operands, complete short address/scan fields and finite controller code. All other labels, arrays, frames, return contexts, numeric loop/cap counters, arithmetic, generator and allocation metadata are in the counted basis-qubit bank, not a duplicate classical stack or measurement transcript. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANK250Q25C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak allocated quantum space is O(n^(5/2)/log2n) qubits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Put ell=max(1,ceil log2n),lambda_bank=ceil(ell/2),E=2^lambda_bank,J=max(1,ceil(E/ell)). Seven fixed regions each C*2^(2ceil(log2(n+2)))*J bits, C=2^48, bound the complete classical-virtual address span. A full-vector pool of2^20ceil(n/ell) slots of16nE bits covers all full tables; final two-label roots have a separate2^17n-slot pool of16n bits. Current tuples/input/source/decoder/arithmetic and all allocator metadata fit the same explicit capacities. Logical coherent cells span O(n), with all ID lists in the bank. The WHOLE paired prefix, every padding wire, coherent data, source scratch, failures, growth and cleanup count, with complete address fees. Section3 proves fixed maximum ranges and slot reuse independently of success. Since J=O(sqrt(n)/logn), total quantum allocation is O(n^(5/2)/logn), jointly with full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANK250Q25C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, all acquired copies number O(2^((1/4)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Exact CQ/source-channel simulation makes one physical request per virtual request and no others, including every failed/discarded EXTRACT, fallback, rejected and aborted acquisition. Local zero bank/padding preparations count as time/quantum storage, not source copies. Complete virtual Section8 proves the literal main nCcap+K<=2^(sqrt(n)/4); finite lengths change only outside constants. The actual request sequence and output law are preserved under independent ideal copies, yielding unconditional full-secret success at least1-2^-8 jointly with all resource/error claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANK250Q25C algorithm/configuration, the guaranteed malformed-source fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. For every N and secret, all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states and the entire secret is recovered with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 jointly with all four physical resource bounds. The CQ simulation permits classical correlations between bank values and coherent registers but proves no transfer to an adaptive malformed supplier that observes extra bank measurements. No positive tolerance or impossibility of greater robustness is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
